criteria.description: Explains the competitor's strategy — who they target, how they position, how they make money — rather than just listing their features.
Gives an honest read of real strengths AND structural (not cosmetic) weaknesses, rather than wishful or one-sided.
Identifies where the competitor wins and where they lose (segments/use cases), with conditions.
Ends with concrete strategic implications and moves for us (avoid / attack / copy / ignore), not just description.
Bases claims on observable signals and flags inferences / what to verify.
